mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (wh.video_id) wh.id, wh.user_id, wh.video_id, wh.episode_id, wh.watched_seconds, wh.play_link, wh.watch_time, vi.avid AS video_avid, vi.title AS video_title, vi.cover_url AS video_cover, u.nike_name AS nick_name, u.avatar AS avatar_url, ve.avid AS episode_avid, ve.title AS episode_title, ve.episode_number FROM public.watch_history wh LEFT JOIN public.video_info vi ON vi.id = wh.video_id AND vi.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN public.video_episode ve ON ve.id = wh.episode_id AND ve.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN public.user_info u ON u.id = vi.user_id WHERE wh.is_delete = 0 AND wh.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY wh.video_id, wh.watch_time DESC ) t ORDER BY t.watch_time DESC
